meaning.high_ids: High-confidence Chisato subtitle events. They still route to review if an unselected subtitle overlaps or the merged clip is shorter than one second.
meaning.probable_ids: Likely Chisato events with speaker, overlap, brevity, effects, or scene-context uncertainty. They always route to review.

warning: ASS speaker names are not reliable. These IDs are inferred, not ground truth.

EP03.note: Dialogue turns were checked against the EP03 DA visit, fountain conversation and mock-battle context. Battle and flashback lines are review candidates because of effects/music; the unusually quiet opening line is also review-only.

EP04.note: The shopping/aquarium dialogue was traced turn by turn. Child-interaction uncertainty and the crowded final underwear gag are routed to review.

EP05.note: Tour-guide turns, the artificial-heart discussion and the Matsushita reveal were checked against scene order. Battle/collapse lines, one early briefing response and a transient-heavy near-0 dBFS line are review candidates.

EP06.note: Cohabitation, safe-house and post-fight dialogue were checked against turn order. Rock-paper-scissors overlaps were excluded; uncertain group-analysis and battle lines are review-only.

EP07.note: Cafe, Forbidden-bar infiltration and Yoshimatsu conversation turns were followed in sequence. The unusually quiet one-word JP298 and the out-of-order overlapping JP421 are review-only.

EP08.note: Cafe, Majima safe-house confrontation and clinic turns were traced speaker by speaker. The flashback/effects lines and one ambiguous Mika-address turn are review-only; robot-voice repetitions were excluded.

EP09.note: Hospital, DA negotiation, field handoff and the final Chisato-Takina outing were traced in sequence. Childhood Chisato and crowded repeated cafe greetings are review-only because their tone or speaker separation is atypical.

EP10.note: Cafe closure, farewells, kimono conversation, Mika reveal and final split-phone sequence were followed turn by turn. The playful opening vocalization and one crowded farewell response are review-only.

EP11.note: Chisato is absent from most of EP11; only the departure, old-radio-tower evacuation and Majima confrontation were selected. Evacuation/action calls with strong effects are review-only.

EP12.note: Old-radio-tower Yoshimatsu confrontation, helicopter briefing and post-rescue turns were checked against the alternating speakers. Opening gunfight, ambiguous rescue handoff, group response and the final Majima greeting are review-only.

EP13.note: Majima debate, hospital escape, island reunion and Hawaii epilogue were traced in scene order. Active-fight lines and the countdown climax are review-only; the long reflective exchange and reunion dialogue are clean candidates.
